title: fix(update): preserve failures when cleanup reporting is unavailable
body:
Related: #169446

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Git updates losing their original failure and skipping temporary-worktree cleanup when cleanup progress cannot be written to update history.

## User Impact

Cleanup still runs when its progress ledger is unavailable. Operators retain the original failure and secondary diagnostics instead of a misleading cleanup-only failure. Reporting alone does not invalidate a successful update or a known pre-mutation recovery classification; uncertain process cleanup still blocks recovery.

This repairs the installed updater's error handling. It cannot patch an older updater already running, and it does not establish the cause of the reported production maintenance collision or prove full macOS service recovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

Record cleanup reporting failures separately from cleanup execution, preserve both failures during unwind, and keep the original admission/revocation classification only for reporting-only aggregation. Existing process-settlement and recovery guards remain active.

Reported and requested by @hannesrudolph.

## Work sessions

- [Original discussion with @hannesrudolph](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/1101c3cc-172f-4ccc-9c90-79c2b7d4da7d)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/547bc626-67d9-4e68-92a5-cac2631c995b)

## Evidence

- Reproduced through real `updateGitCheckout` on main `b17443fb0fb3862e94df2c56203cf0171c98a142` using synthetic local Git repositories (real Git I/O; simulated package builds and service stop): control passed; injecting cleanup-start ledger failure ran zero worktree-removal commands and failed the regression. Installed HEAD remained unchanged. No live Gateway or operator data was used.
- Repaired entrypoint proof covers cleanup-start and cleanup-completion failures, original-error retention, unchanged installed HEAD after pre-mutation failure, successful updates with reporting warnings, and refusal to delete scratch while process cleanup is uncertain: **5 passed**.
- CLI recovery regression covers preserved original recovery metadata plus continued refusal for uncertain cleanup and pending recovery: **6 passed**.
- Focused command: `pnpm test src/infra/update-runner-git-cleanup.test.ts src/cli/update-cli/update-command-cleanup-recovery.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`. Final wall time 41.26 s including 28.62 s of compiled-worker preparation; the new integration file took 33.97 s including that preparation (about 1 s in its tests), and the CLI file took 4.13 s (0.04 s in its tests). CI job startup varies. The real Git preflight/transfer/cleanup boundary is required to catch the skipped-removal defect; a helper-only mock would not prove that flow.
- Independent autoreview: scoped-clean, no blocking findings. The exact CI rollback assertion failure was reproduced and corrected to verify the retained error identity/cause; the complete Git candidate, cleanup and CLI recovery suites then passed (targeted lint and infra test types also passed).
- Final six-file update/admission/command-diagnostic/recovery/public-report run after the settlement correction: **88 passed**, 86.24 s wall. Targeted lint: **0 warnings, 0 errors**. Final core and CLI-update typechecks, schema, legacy-store, media, runtime-sidecar, import-cycle and auth/webhook guards pass. `pnpm check:changed` passed its earlier guards and core typecheck, then stopped on four type errors in unchanged MCP UI fixtures (`mcp-app-unmount.test.ts` / `mcp-app-view.test.ts`). The exact four errors reproduce independently on clean current main `a22eb8a59bf128028182918d1c67df12eefe955c` with `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.ui-components.json --incremental`; this PR changes none of those files. These are not reported as passing checks. Final touched-core and CLI-update typechecks pass. The full-tree unused-export scan also reports existing-looking exports in untouched agent/UI files; no cleanup of those unrelated exports is included, and that scan is not claimed green.
